name: Vantablack Executive Overcoat
description:
A full-length structured overcoat in charcoal-black wool-cashmere blend, double-breasted with six covered buttons and a notched lapel that lies perfectly flat regardless of movement. The silhouette is architectural — padded shoulders, a defined waist, a hem that falls just below the knee. The lining is silk-analog in deep burgundy. Internal pockets are cut to hold documents, a sidearm, or both without visible distortion of the exterior line.

Vantablack's executive line is built for Tier 4 corporate environments. This coat signals that you run the meeting, not just attend it. The wool comes from a proprietary geneware flock in Iceland — the fibers are slightly finer than natural merino, with a subtle luster. No tech. It doesn't need any.
what_it_says: Authority, and the money to dress like it. This person makes decisions that affect other people's lives and is comfortable with that.
story_hooks: The coat's internal pocket dimensions are non-standard — exactly sized for a particular data-slab format that only one corponation currently uses
A Tier 4 executive was found dead wearing this coat; the burgundy lining makes it impossible to tell how long she'd been bleeding
Someone in a Tier 1 market is selling a coat that matches this description exactly, and they claim they found it
related_entities: Arcturus Defense Solutions ChemoShield BX-2 Dermal Toxin Barrier Implant

physical_description.visual_profile: A commanding full-length overcoat with architectural precision. The silhouette reads as power through restraint—broad padded shoulders that taper to a defined waist, then flares subtly to a knee-grazing hem. The double-breasted front and perfectly flat notched lapels create severe vertical lines. Worn by someone with authority, this coat moves like armor.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not tight. The shoulder pad is substantial but structured, not exaggerated. Sleeve length hits at the wrist bone. The body drapes with deliberate ease—not oversized, never slouchy. Built for someone who stands still and makes decisions.
physical_description.primary_material: Wool-cashmere blend from proprietary Icelandic geneware flock. The fibers are fractionally finer than natural merino, engineered for durability and sheen without fragility. Charcoal-black with minimal weave visibility.
physical_description.texture: Dense and smooth to the touch, with a subtle luster that catches light without shine. The nap is uniform and directionless. Deep burgundy silk-analog lining provides tactile luxury against skin. No visible texture disturbance—the weave is almost abstract.
physical_description.color_scheme: Absolute charcoal black exterior with almost imperceptible warmth in the weave. Deep burgundy silk-analog lining visible at lapels, cuffs, and hem. Six covered buttons in matte gunmetal-gray, understated and functional.
physical_description.closures: Six covered buttons in brushed gunmetal, evenly spaced down the double-breasted front. Buttons are recessed slightly to maintain the coat's clean line. No magnetic snaps—this is old-money engineering, not street-tech.
distinctive_features: Internal document pockets cut at chest and hip—deep enough for a thin sidearm without silhouette distortion
Padded shoulders with architectural precision—structured but not aggressive
Notched lapels that lie impossibly flat regardless of movement
Hem finished with a subtle interior tape that prevents creasing
Burgundy silk-analog lining visible only at intentional points—lapels, cuffs, hem interior
Vantablack Corporate Apparel Division tag in discrete serif font at interior right shoulder seam
The material shows almost no wear over time—designed for decades of use
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 1–2 luxury corporate wear. The price point is significant, but the signal is restraint, not ostentation. This is what executives wear when they don't need to prove anything.
physical_description.cultural_context: Corpo hierarchy. This coat says you sit in the meeting, not serve it. Worn by board members, division leads, and senior security apparatus. The wearer is almost certainly augmented subcutaneously—this coat was built for someone with a corporate datasocket. Zero street presence. Zero military overtones. Pure institutional power.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine or nearly so. Minor creasing at the elbows and cuffs from normal wear, but this garment is meant to look fresh. The wearer likely has it pressed weekly. No visible distressing, patching, or fading. When new, it looks like it cost Φ 12,000+. Years later, it looks almost identical.
